name: Irogae Mizore
source:
One of the protagonist’s seniors who’s in strangely high spirits. Despite his appearance, he’s quite an outdoorsman and his grades are among the highest in his year. Has the temperament of a prodigy, which means his attitude can create friction between himself and others, but he seems to live optimistically without worrying too much about this. Looks like he’s currently the head of the science club, though...?

‘‘Sup, blockheads~ Let’s get all fired up today as well!’
‘Yup, that’s incorrect. The fact that I’m cute is common knowledge all around the world~’

[Translated from [url=https://twitter.com/mekakare_love]the official Twitter[/url].]
